item.text:
No additional defect was confirmed in this pass. The authorized scope has been exercised across protocol tests, API edge cases, storage fault paths, feature combinations, and crash/recovery stress without yielding a new finding beyond the 28 already documented.

Highest-impact confirmed issues remain:

- LFU cache resynchronization producing different replica values at the same index,
- delta-snapshot synchronization corruption,
- decided-index regression during `AcceptSync`,
- persistent failed-write leakage and destructive suffix replacement,
- timeout retry duplication,
- LRU bincode deserialization failure.

The complete report and verified replay workflow remain available at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
